steps.text: Asks for the Wine 11 engine r27 or newer. On the default engine a player on an M5 Pro got 5 to 10 fps on Wine's own Direct3D and a crash at the loading screen in every other mode. On the Wine 11 engine the same player plays it in Wine's own Direct3D, DXMT or Apple's DirectX 12 support, with some frame drops in heavy scenes (highball#385, 2026-10-25). DXVK crashes at the loading screen on both engines, so pick another mode if the environment is set to DXVK. Play passes -oldgameui, which the game needs to start. Everything installed in the environment stays.
